Ganesh Hatha is the photographer behind Lifeshots Photography. His photography experience dates from 2013, spanning weddings, events and portraits.

Lifeshots offers wedding and pre-wedding photography, fashion and celebrity portraits, maternity and baby shoots, and videography. Explore the collection, then share the occasion you have in mind.
